entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:1
segments: For the rest, then, my brothers, we beseech you and exhort [you] in [the] Lord Jesus, that, as you have received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, so you would abound more [and more].

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:2
segments: For we know what commands we gave you by the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:3
segments: For this is the will of God, your sanctification, for you to abstain from fornication,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:4
segments: each one of you to know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honor

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:5
segments: (not in the passion of lust, even as the nations who do not know God),

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:6
segments: not to go beyond and defraud his brother in this matter (because the Lord [is the] avenger concerning all these, as we also have forewarned you and testified).

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:7
segments: For God has not called us to uncleanness, but in sanctification.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:8
segments: Therefore he who despises does not despise man, but God, who also has given us His Holy Spirit.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:9
segments: But regarding brotherly love, you do not need that I write to you, for you yourselves are taught by God to love one another.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:10
segments: And indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we beseech you, brothers, that you abound more [and more],

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:11
segments: and that you try earnestly to be quiet and to do [your] own business, and to work with your own hands, as we commanded you,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:12
segments: so that you may walk becomingly toward those outside, and that you may lack nothing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:13
segments: But I would not have you ignorant, brothers, concerning those who are asleep, that you be not grieved, even as others who have no hope.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:14
segments: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will also bring with Him all those who have fallen asleep through Jesus.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:15
segments: For we say this to you by the Word of [the] Lord, that we who are alive [and] remain until the coming of the Lord shall not go before those who are asleep.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:16
segments: For the Lord Himself shall descend from Heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ shall rise first.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:17
segments: Then we who are alive [and] remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. And so we shall ever be with the Lord.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 4:18
segments: Therefore comfort one another with these words.
